# IT Operations Security Review and Audit Findings

This document details critical actions required following recent audit findings:

*   Urgent review of firewall settings.
*   Monitoring of API latency standard updates.
*   Review of firewall settings based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitoring of API latency based on audit recommendations.
*   Review of database migration based on audit recommendations.
